sum: Eldeco Housing and Industries Limited filed a mandatory disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, indicating a substantial acquisition event requiring exchange notification.
detail: Eldeco Housing and Industries Limited, a real-estate and housing developer, submitted a formal disclosure to NSE under SEBI Takeover Regulations. Regulation 31(4) requires persons acquiring shares to file detailed disclosures of their intent, funding, and shareholding structure within two trading days of crossing a 5% or 10% threshold. The filing appears to relate to a substantial acquisition event; full particulars of the acquirer, acquisition price, and target shareholding percentage are contained in the formal disclosure document submitted to NSE.
